newsitem.title: CANADA: CN to sell US$108.3 mln in certificates.
newsitem.headline: CN to sell US$108.3 mln in certificates.

text.p: Canadian National Railway Co said on Tuesday it filed a preliminary prospectus with securities commissions in Quebec and the United States for the issue and sale in the United States of US$108.3 million in pass through certificates to finance the acquisition of 105 new high-horsepower locomotives.
It said financing should be completed by the end of September.
The locomotives are being made by General Motors of Canada Ltd's Diesel Division, CN said. The purchase is part of a plan to replace about 543 locomotives with 394 new units.
